source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; FSSAI Labelling and Display Regulations, 2020; Cosmetics Rules, 2020
disclaimer: This matrix defines statutory and internal packaging compliance screening rules for AI-assisted inspection. Automated screening does not constitute final legal enforcement.

rules.source_authority: Internal Inspection Screening Specification
rules.exception: Internal inspection identity field for commercial brand/product identification. Statutory common or generic name is governed separately under Rule 6(1)(b) as GENERIC_NAME (PC-ALL-010).
rules.citation_text: Internal inspection identity field for brand/product name identification. Not a statutory declaration under Legal Metrology Rule 6(1)(b); common or generic name is governed separately under GENERIC_NAME.
rules.applicability: Universal internal inspection tracking across retail and wholesale packages
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection and OCR extraction of commercial brand name and product title text.
rules.physical_scope: Trademark registry verification, brand portfolio classification.
rules.notes: Commercial or brand product name identification. Note: Statutory declaration under Rule 6(1)(b) mandates the common or generic name (GENERIC_NAME); brand/product name is screened as packaging identification convention.

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(c), Rule 11, Rule 12, Rule 13, Rule 13(6) [Retail]; Rule 24(c) [Wholesale]
rules.exception: Multipack declaration structure maintains: declared expression, pack count, unit quantity, unit, and derived total per Rule 13(6). The printed declaration must not be replaced by the calculated total.
rules.citation_text: Rule 6(1)(c): the net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned. Rule 13(6): packages containing multiple individual units of the same commodity shall declare pack count and unit quantity. Rule 24(c): wholesale package shall declare total number of retail packages or net quantity.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for all retail packages under Rule 6(1)(c) and wholesale packages under Rule 24(c)
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection of printed numerical quantity and statutory metric unit (g, kg, ml, l, m, cm, mm, N, U) or multipack statement (e.g. 3 x 100 g).
rules.physical_scope: Physical gravimetric/volumetric net fill determination using calibrated balances under Rule 19 and Third Schedule; compliance with Second Schedule Maximum Permissible Error (MPE).
rules.notes: Governs printed net quantity expression on label. Physical net weight verification is governed separately under ACTUAL_NET_CONTENT (PC-ALL-012).

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Mandatory for retail packages intended for direct consumer sale under Chapter II. Wholesale packages under Chapter III / Rule 24 and packages for institutional/industrial consumers under Rule 3 & 26 are exempt from retail price declarations.
rules.citation_text: the retail sale price of the package shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes and the price in Indian currency.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for retail packages; NOT_APPLICABLE for wholesale packages under Rule 24 or institutional/industrial supply
rules.screening_scope: Detection of 'MRP', 'Maximum Retail Price', currency indicator ('₹', 'Rs.'), numerical price, and inclusive of all taxes statement.
rules.physical_scope: Distributor invoice reconciliation, overcharging investigations, anti-profiteering audits.
rules.notes: Applicability is strictly restricted to retail packages. Absence on wholesale outer packaging does not constitute a non-compliance.

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Label may distinguish Manufacturer, Packer, Marketer, or Importer as distinct semantic roles; identity of manufacturer or packer is mandatory.
rules.citation_text: Rule 6(1)(a): the name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer and for any imported package the name and address of the importer. Rule 24(a): name and address of manufacturer, packer, or person on whose behalf package is packed.
rules.applicability: Mandatory across all retail (Rule 6(1)(a)) and wholesale (Rule 24(a)) packages
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection of manufacturer/packer/marketer corporate identity text and associated designation.
rules.physical_scope: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) registration check, factory operating licence, contract manufacturing agreements.
rules.notes: Separate semantic roles (Manufacturer, Packer, Marketer, Importer) are preserved as distinct fields.

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Rule 10 specifies that the address shall be complete postal address containing street, city, state, and PIN code.
rules.citation_text: Rule 10: complete postal address at which the factory is situated or where commodity is packed or registered office, including town, state and PIN code.
rules.applicability: Mandatory across all retail and wholesale packages
rules.screening_scope: Text presence of address components (street, industrial area, city, state, postal code).
rules.physical_scope: Physical site verification of registered manufacturing or packing facility.
rules.notes: Must indicate complete physical/postal location of manufacturing or packing unit.

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Mandatory for imported packages; NOT_APPLICABLE to domestic products.
rules.citation_text: the name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products shall be mentioned on the package.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for imported commodities (Retail & Wholesale); NOT_APPLICABLE to domestic goods
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection of 'Country of Origin', 'Made in [Country]', or foreign country declaration.
rules.physical_scope: Customs Bill of Entry, Certificate of Origin, import documentation audit.
rules.notes: Inserted via G.S.R. 629(E) dated 23 June 2017 with commencement from 1 January 2018.

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Mandatory for imported packages; NOT_APPLICABLE to domestic products.
rules.citation_text: for any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for imported commodities; NOT_APPLICABLE to domestic goods
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection of 'Imported by', 'Importer', company name and Indian address.
rules.physical_scope: Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) Importer-Exporter Code (IEC), customs declarations.
rules.notes: Required on both retail and wholesale imported packages.

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Mandatory for retail packages under Rule 6(2). Food packages cross-reference this requirement under FSSR (Labelling and Display) 2020 Regulation 5(11). Wholesale packages under Rule 24 are NOT required to declare consumer care details on outer wholesale cartons.
rules.citation_text: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, e-mail address of the person who can be or the office which can be, contacted, in case of consumer complaints.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for retail packages; NOT_APPLICABLE for wholesale packages under Rule 24
rules.screening_scope: Optical presence of telephone/toll-free helpline, email address, or designated consumer contact postal address.
rules.physical_scope: Operational test call or email to verify responsiveness of complaint cell.
rules.notes: Preserves statutory cross-reference relationship with FSSR (Labelling and Display) Regulation 5(11).

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Rule 6(1)(d) proviso specifies that for food commodities governed under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, date marking shall be as per FSSAI regulations. Not mandatory on wholesale outer packaging under Rule 24.
rules.citation_text: the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned: Provided that for commodities governed under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (34 of 2006) and the rules and regulations made thereunder, date marking shall be as per the provisions of that Act and rules and regulations.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for non-food retail commodities under Rule 6(1)(d); food date marking routed conditionally to FSSAI (PC-FOOD-001); NOT_APPLICABLE for wholesale outer packaging
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection of manufacturing or packing month and year in valid numeric or text format.
rules.physical_scope: Plant batch production logs, QA release certificates.
rules.notes: Preserves statutory proviso routing food package date-marking through food law.

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Mandatory statutory declaration under Rule 6(1)(b) for retail packages and Rule 24(b) for wholesale packages for the generic or common name of the commodity contained in the package.
rules.citation_text: Rule 6(1)(b): the common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product shall be specified on the package. Rule 24(b): the identity of the commodity contained in the package.
rules.applicability: Mandatory across all retail and wholesale pre-packaged commodities
rules.screening_scope: Optical presence of common or generic descriptor (e.g., 'Iodized Salt', 'Talcum Powder', 'Refined Sugar') on the packaging.
rules.physical_scope: Commodity standard validation against applicable Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) or FSSAI product standards.
rules.notes: Distinguished from commercial product/brand name. Receives the official Legal Metrology citation under Rule 6(1)(b).

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Mandatory on applicable retail packages since 1 January 2024. Exempt if Retail Sale Price and Unit Sale Price are identical (e.g. 1 kg, 1 l, 1 unit), or for combination, group, or multi-piece packages. NOT_APPLICABLE on wholesale packages per Rule 24 and official DCA FAQ.
rules.citation_text: The unit sale price shall be declared on every pre-packaged commodity in rupees, rounded off to the nearest two decimal places, per g, kg, ml, l, or number. Provided that declaration of unit sale price is not required where retail sale price and unit sale price are identical, or for combination/multi-piece packages.
rules.applicability: Retail packages (subject to unit price parity exemptions); strictly NOT_APPLICABLE on wholesale packages under Rule 24
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection of '₹... / g', '₹... / kg', '₹... / ml', '₹... / piece' or 'USP' statement on display panel.
rules.physical_scope: Mathematical verification of unit rate against declared net quantity and retail sale price.
rules.notes: Enforced from 1 January 2024 following deferrals. Absence on a genuine wholesale package is not non-compliance.

rules.source_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
rules.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.exception: Governed by FSSR (Labelling and Display) 2020 Regulation 5(10) (mandatory compliance enforced from 1 July 2022). Applies to retail food packages. Future draft amendment notifications are not applied prior to their gazetted effective date.
rules.instrument: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.citation_text: Date of manufacture or packaging and Expiry/Use by date: (a) Date of manufacture or packaging shall be declared; (b) Expiry date or Use by date shall be declared on the label in the prescribed format.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for retail food products; NOT_APPLICABLE for non-food
rules.screening_scope: Detection of 'Best Before', 'Use By', 'Expiry Date', 'Exp' and valid date string.
rules.physical_scope: Accelerated and real-time shelf-life testing dossiers, microbiological stability reports.
rules.notes: Currently effective baseline is Regulation 5(10) of the 2020 Regulations. Enforced from 1 July 2022.

rules.source_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
rules.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.exception: Exempt under Regulation 5(2)(a) for single-ingredient commodities such as pure white sugar, table salt, or raw agricultural produce.
rules.instrument: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.citation_text: A complete list of ingredients shall be declared on the label in descending order of in-going weight (m/m) or volume (v/v) at the time of their manufacture. Single ingredient commodities are exempt under Regulation 5(2)(a).
rules.applicability: Mandatory for multi-ingredient retail food; exempt for single-ingredient foods
rules.screening_scope: Optical presence of 'Ingredients:' header and comma-separated ingredient names.
rules.physical_scope: Factory batch formulation sheets, quantitative ingredient declarations, allergen cross-contamination logs.
rules.notes: Enforced from 1 July 2022 under FSSR (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020.

rules.source_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
rules.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.exception: Exempt under Regulation 5(3) proviso for raw agricultural commodities, unprocessed produce, packaged water, table salt, and single-ingredient sugars.
rules.instrument: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.citation_text: Nutritional information shall be declared on the label per 100g or 100ml or per single consumption pack: energy, protein, carbohydrate, total sugars, added sugars, total fat, saturated fat, trans fat, and sodium.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for processed multi-ingredient food; exempt for raw commodities, salt, sugar
rules.screening_scope: Optical presence of nutrition table / panel and values for Energy, Protein, Carbohydrate, Fat, Sodium.
rules.physical_scope: Laboratory nutritional analysis from NABL-accredited / FSSAI-recognized laboratory.
rules.notes: Statutory provisions set out in Regulation 5(3) of FSSR (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020.

rules.source_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
rules.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.rule_reference: FSSR (Labelling & Display) 2020 Reg 5(7) & Licensing Reg 2011 Reg 2.1.2
rules.exception: Display of FSSAI logo and 14-digit licence number is mandatory. Label detection confirms presence only; validity and authenticity require official FoSCoS portal verification.
rules.instrument: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.citation_text: The FSSAI logo and license number of the brand owner shall be displayed on the label of the food package in contrast colour to the background. Manufacturing unit license number shall also be displayed.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for all food packages (Retail & Wholesale)
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection of FSSAI logo graphic and valid 14-digit numeric license identifier.
rules.physical_scope: FSSAI Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS) portal verification of license status, validity period, and authorized product categories.
rules.notes: Visual detection cannot independently prove licence authenticity; verification against official FoSCoS portal is required for enforcement.

rules.source_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
rules.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.exception: Visual detection of the veg/non-veg symbol is an image screening heuristic. Low-confidence visual detection remains REVIEW / NOT_VERIFIABLE. Visual detection confidence is not legal compliance.
rules.instrument: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.citation_text: Every package of Vegetarian food shall bear a declaration to this effect by a symbol in green colour consisting of a filled circle inside a square; Non-Vegetarian food shall bear a symbol in brown colour.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for all food retail packages; NOT_APPLICABLE to cosmetics or household goods
rules.screening_scope: Computer vision color segmentation and geometry detection of green/brown dot in square.
rules.physical_scope: Raw material origin verification, animal derivative analysis, halal/kosher certification inspection.
rules.notes: Visual detection must distinguish detected symbol candidate from legal compliance. Low confidence remains REVIEW.

rules.source_authority: Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
rules.exception: Rule 34(1)(e) requires distinctive batch number preceded by 'B' or 'Batch No.' or 'B. No.' or 'Lot No.' or 'Lot'.
rules.citation_text: a distinctive batch number, that is to say, the number by reference to which details of manufacture of the particular batch from which the substance in the container is taken are recorded and are available for inspection, preceded by 'B' or 'Batch No.' or 'B. No.' or 'Lot'.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for cosmetic packages under Cosmetics Rules, 2020
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection of batch prefix ('Batch No.', 'B.No.', 'Lot') and valid alphanumeric code.
rules.physical_scope: Manufacturer batch manufacturing record (BMR), quality release certificate.
rules.notes: Governed by Cosmetics Rules, 2020 under Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940.

rules.source_authority: Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
rules.exception: Rule 34(1)(h) requires ingredient list using International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) in descending order.
rules.citation_text: the list of ingredients, using the International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) in descending order of weight or volume at the time they are added, preceded by the word 'INGREDIENTS'.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for retail cosmetic products
rules.screening_scope: Optical detection of 'INGREDIENTS' heading and INCI cosmetic chemical nomenclature.
rules.physical_scope: Formula disclosure, toxicological safety assessment, BIS standard conformity.
rules.notes: Replaces outdated Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 provisions.

rules.source_authority: Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
rules.exception: Rule 34(1)(f) requires manufacturing date and expiry date or use before date.
rules.citation_text: the manufacturing date and expiry date or use before date, that is to say, the month and year in which the cosmetic was manufactured and the month and year up to which the cosmetic is safe to use, preceded by 'Expiry' or 'Use before'.
rules.applicability: Mandatory for retail cosmetic products
rules.screening_scope: Detection of 'Use Before', 'Expiry', 'Best Before', or 'Exp Date' with valid date format.
rules.physical_scope: Preservative efficacy testing dossiers and stability data.
rules.notes: Statutory requirement under Rule 34(1)(f) of Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.source_document: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 & Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.rule_reference: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 Sec 18; LMPC Rules Rule 14 & Sched II; Rule 19 & Sched III
rules.exception: Physical verification procedure referenced separately under Section 18 of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009; determination of net quantity under Rule 19 & Third Schedule; permissible error tolerances under Rule 14 & Second Schedule. Rule 24 does NOT govern physical weighing.
rules.citation: LM Act Sec 18, Rule 14 (Sched II), Rule 19 (Sched III)
rules.citation_text: Section 18, Legal Metrology Act, 2009: Prohibits non-conforming pre-packaged commodities. Rule 19 & Third Schedule: Procedure for inspection and determination of net quantity of commodities in packages. Rule 14 & Second Schedule: Maximum Permissible Errors (MPE).
rules.applicability: Universal physical verification requirement across all packages
rules.screening_scope: NONE: Visual screening cannot determine actual physical net contents, tare weight, or gravimetric net fill.
rules.physical_scope: Direct gravimetric measurement using calibrated standard scale apparatus following Third Schedule sampling protocol.
rules.notes: Corrected from previous erroneous attribution to Rule 24. Rule 24 is wholesale package labelling, NOT physical weighing.

rules.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
rules.exception: Visual screening cannot confirm physical millimetre height. Physical measurement of numeral and letter height in millimeters using calibrated gauge or caliper under Rule 7 Table-I/II required.
rules.citation_text: Rule 7(3): The minimum height of any numeral and letter on every package shall be as specified in Table-I or Table-II, as the case may be, based on net quantity and area of principal display panel.
rules.applicability: All pre-packaged commodities (physical verification required)
rules.screening_scope: NONE: VISUAL SCREENING CANNOT CONFIRM PHYSICAL MILLIMETRE HEIGHT without calibrated optics and physical scale reference.
rules.physical_scope: Physical measurement of numeral/letter height in millimeters using calibrated optical graticule, millimeter gauge, or Vernier caliper against Rule 7 Table-I/II thresholds.
rules.notes: Automated screening system explicitly reports that visual screening cannot confirm physical millimetre height when physical measurement is unavailable.
